Field Descriptions

irq_test

Interrupt test. When 1, forces irq_o high for verification / firmware bring-up.

irq_en

Interrupt enable. When 1, a timeout event propagates to irq_o.

enable

When 1, the timeout counter runs. When 0, it is held at 0 and irq_o is forced low.
